lines.text: The apostles reported all they had done and taught, then went with Jesus by boat to a solitary place.
Crowds ran on foot from all the towns and arrived first, and Jesus had compassion on them and taught them.
Jesus told the disciples to feed the crowd, and they asked about spending three hundred denarii on bread.
Jesus had the people sit on the green grass, blessed the loaves, and divided the fish among them all.
All ate and were satisfied, and the disciples gathered seven basketfuls of pieces, and five thousand men had eaten.
